MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 42

2. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 13

3. Solve for x: x + 3 = 11. (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 8
   C. 3
   D. 11

4. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 22

5. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 7
   C. 7
   D. 5

6. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 0

7. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 40

8. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 90

10. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x < 5
   B. x > 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x = 5

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

12. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 2
   C. 49
   D. 48

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — 36
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Area of square = side × side
2. Substitute values: Area = 6 × 6
3. Area = 36
Final Answer: 36 m²
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

2. B — 169
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 13² = 13 × 13
3. 13² = 169
Final Answer: 169
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

3. B — 8
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: x = RHS − constant
2. Substitute values: x = 11 − 3
3. x = 8
Final Answer: x = 8
Mark reminder: method mark; accuracy mark

4. A — 121
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: Square = number × number
2. Substitute values: 11² = 11 × 11
3. 11² = 121
Final Answer: 121

5. D — 5
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 3² + 4²
3. c² = 9 + 16
4. c² = 25
5. c = 5
Final Answer: 5 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

Working:
